gates.name: Run the sample in both roles
Assert no framework project references a workload
Start the workload and the edge, the documented way
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && GAME_SERVICE_PORT=8080 npm start; then start workloads/game-edge .../SubZeroDev.Platform.GameEdge.dll with GameEdge__WorkloadBaseAddress=http://127.0.0.1:8080 ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://127.0.0.1:5080; curl /livez /readyz /health/live /health/ready

gates.name: Run the replay against the workload
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/replay.test.ts

gates.name: Run the replay against the edge
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && GAME_EDGE_DLL=<built edge dll> npx vitest run tests/replay-edge.test.ts

gates.name: Migrate the schema to head, the documented way
Start the workload against the durable store, the documented way
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && GAME_SERVICE_PORT=8081 GAME_SERVICE_STORAGE=durable GAME_SERVICE_DB_CONNECTION_STRING=postgresql://game_service:game_service@127.0.0.1:5432/game_service GAME_SERVICE_DB_SCHEMA=ci_documented_durable_start npm start; curl /readyz

gates.name: Run the one-instance contention proof
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/contention-one-instance.test.ts

gates.name: Run the two-instance contention proof
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/contention-two-instances.test.ts

gates.name: Run the durable replay
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/durable-replay.test.ts

gates.name: Run the port-conformance suite
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/conformance.test.ts

gates.name: Test (game-service)
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && GAME_EDGE_DLL=<built edge dll> npm test

gates.name: Validate Markdown links, terminology, and generated files
Build and verify the status-page site
gates.command: npm --prefix site ci && npm --prefix site run check
